title: Convert Number Words to Digits
summary: Scan s from left to right. When an English digit word begins at the current position, append its digit and advance by the word's full length. Otherwise skip one character. Return the extracted digit string, possibly empty; overlapping starts inside a consumed word are not reconsidered.
